script.cover_1: A small thing, said quickly, can fill a whole evening.
script.payoff: Small asks stack up, and the junior never dares to say the pile is full.
script.caption: Small tasks add up to a long evening. Send this to the manager whose small things never end.
script.sent: Just a small thing, do it quickly.
script.lands: Small things stack up, and the junior may not dare to say the pile is full.
script.better: This should take about an hour. Can it go by 5 pm?
script.why: It sizes the task and sets a time, so the junior can say if it fits.
